title: Multitask deep learning predicts geographic atrophy area and growth rate from FAF and OCT
summary: Models were developed on lampalizumab trial data (1279 development and 443 holdout eyes). Growth-rate r2 on the holdout was 0.47-0.48, and the FAF model reached growth-rate r2 of 0.65 and 0.47 on two independent trial test sets (106 and 169 eyes), with lesion-area r2 of 0.98 and 0.95. The analysis is retrospective and growth-rate prediction is moderate.
ai_technology: Multitask deep learning models on fundus autofluorescence and OCT (FAF-only, OCT-only, multimodal)
